en.headline: Very hot weather and yellow fire danger warnings in force
en.dek: The Observatory kept the Very Hot Weather Warning up for National Day and issued a yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am, forecasting 34 degrees in urban areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Very Hot Weather Warning remained in force this morning after being issued at 11.15am on 28 September. A yellow Fire Danger Warning was issued at 6am on Thursday. The forecast for National Day is mainly fine and extremely hot in some areas, with an urban high around 34 degrees and a couple of degrees higher in the New Territories, before cloud, a few showers and a chance of isolated thunderstorms later.

The Observatory advised the public to drink water, avoid overexertion outdoors and watch for dizziness, nausea or confusion, especially among older people, young children, pregnant women and those with chronic illness. People working in heat were told to follow Labour Department guidance on preventing heat stroke.

The yellow fire danger signal warns that vegetation can ignite more easily in dry, hot conditions. Hikers and countryside visitors were reminded not to light fires where they are prohibited. The Observatory said more showers over the next couple of days should ease the extreme heat, with cooler mornings of about 24 to 25 degrees early next week.

zh.headline: 國慶酷熱及黃色火災危險警告生效
zh.dek: 天文台酷熱天氣警告自九月二十八日上午十一時十五分生效，今早六時再發黃色火災危險警告，市區最高氣溫約34度。
body: 香港天文台表示，酷熱天氣警告今早仍然生效，該警告於九月二十八日上午十一時十五分發出。黃色火災危險警告於十月一日上午六時發出。國慶當日預測大致天晴，部分地區極端酷熱，市區最高氣溫約34度，新界再高一兩度，稍後轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨，局部地區可能有雷暴。
天文台呼籲市民多補充水分，避免在戶外過度勞累，若出現頭暈、噁心或神志不清應立刻休息求助。長者、幼童、孕婦及長期病患者較易中暑。在高溫環境工作的人士應參照勞工處預防工作時中暑指引。
黃色火災危險警告提醒在乾燥炎熱天氣下草木較易着火，郊遊人士不應在禁火範圍生火。天文台展望未來一兩日驟雨較多，高溫將緩和，下週初早上最低氣溫約24至25度。
